title: Suite verdict record of one release-v6 attempt

v3_error_independence.$comment: release-v6 has no generation path and cannot verify V3; the verifier derives this value, never the caller, and the product gate refuses a release-v6 record with any other value

prior_sealed_set_sha256s.$comment: sealed_dataset_sha256 of every prior attempt, in attempt order; the record's own sealed set is none of them

prior_attempts_sha256.$comment: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the manifest's prior_attempts list (sets, expectations and outcomes)

dispatch_journal_head.$comment: entry_sha256 of the last entry of the manifest's dispatch journal when the suite was verified; null only when the journal did not verify (the suite is then incomplete)

manifest_commit_ref.$comment: the commit id or external timestamp reference under which the manifest sha256 was committed before the first dispatch, as recorded in the dispatch journal header; audited after the verdict

critic_transport_identity.$comment: provider_reported when every critic call of every submitted trial recorded the provider-reported served model (equal to the configured model) and the provider request id; not_attested otherwise. The product gate refuses a pass that is not provider_reported.

judge_transport_identity.$comment: provider_reported when every judged semantic item of every submitted result has a durable raw judge response with the judge provider's reported model (equal to run_identity.judge_model) and request id; not_attested otherwise. The product gate refuses a pass that is not provider_reported.

run_stopped.$comment: true when the dispatch journal holds a stop entry (written by the T077 dispatcher when it enforces the USD hard stop); read from the journal, never supplied by the caller. The product gate refuses a pass of a stopped run.

allOf.$comment: audit 5: a pass is provider-attested on the critic and the judge side and comes from an unstopped run
